primary_sources.title: LeetCode 516 — Longest Palindromic Subsequence
claims: The task returns the length of the longest palindromic subsequence of s.
A subsequence preserves the relative order of retained characters while deleting some or no characters.
The official constraints are 1 <= s.length <= 1000 and lowercase English letters only.
The official examples include bbbab -> 4 and cbbd -> 2.
